name: web-integration-diagram-with-arc-of-round-icons
title: Sharing feature illustration with cards and a curved arc of round icons
whatItIs: A white area with two cards at left (event listing with thumbnails, share link with social icons) and, at right, a pale arc of circular blue-outline icons (link, phone, calendar, web, mail) ending in a long pill with the product logo and 'Calendar'.
whatItMeans: Clean and explanatory; the arc shows one calendar flowing to many channels.
techniques: Arrange circular icons along a soft arc to show distribution.
End the arc with a large pill carrying the product.
Use tiny UI cards with thumbnails to illustrate outputs.
Keep everything in blue outline on white.

vocabulary.definition: A mini UI card showing a result.
A long capsule with a logo and label.
A pictogram drawn with line only.
